goal.objective: Observe one exact non-sensitive DEVICE<->KV InTr request/response when either authentic relay Node-KV continuity or a verified canonical device-kv event-materialization ingress is available, preserving reconstructable evidence without requiring an always-running receiver.
success_predicates: Either authentic relay Node-KV continuity or a verified stegverse.device-kv-intr-materialization-ingress/v1 event is available.
Exact request bytes traverse a bounded deployment-local TCP carrier from DEVICE to the KV boundary receiver.
The receiver binds the request to the authentic parent Node-KV continuity identity and issues a canonical DEVICE->KV InTr receipt only after receiving the bytes.
The merged continuity-vault-kit KVInterlockRuntime consumes the verified envelope and receipt reference.
Exact response bytes traverse the carrier from KV to DEVICE with a canonical chained KV->DEVICE receipt.
Durable receipt readback and reconstruction preserve exact request/response/receipt identities.
No personal data, credential, provider operation, canonical KV mutation, route authority, or execution authority is created.
failure_predicates: Hosted CI or fixture evidence substitutes for deployment-local byte transport.
The worker fabricates VERIFIED boundary state without either authentic relay continuity or independently validated canonical event-ingress evidence.
A second runtime owner, endpoint authority, scheduler, HeartBeat, credential path, or transport broker is created.
GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret becomes runtime authority.
HIL or G18 completion is treated as a prerequisite or their claim/fence is consumed.
A transport receipt is emitted before the receiver has received and validated the corresponding bytes.

authority.authority_source: StegVerse-Labs/.github#575 + existing SHWP-DEVICE-KV-INTR-OBSERVATION-001 independent task authority; TV/TVC unchanged

controlled_operation.minimum_necessary_justification: Observe transport integrity without personal-record access.

completion.terminal_evidence: receipts/device-kv-intr/SHWP-DEVICE-KV-INTR-OBSERVATION-001.json with state OBSERVED and capability_type DEVICE_KV_INTR
terminal_when: a verified device-kv materialization ingress exists OR authentic parent relay continuity is verified
request and response exact bytes are independently transported and rehashed
canonical DEVICE->KV and KV->DEVICE receipt hashes and lineage validate
KVInterlockRuntime response is bound to the request receipt reference
durable readback/reconstruction preserves the same execution identity
credential authority remains TV/TVC with no credential material
canonical KV mutation and provider operation remain false
completion.next_authorized_action: On the next admitted device-kv Universal InTr materialization event, shared profiled ingress persists the request/ingress receipt and dispatches the non-authorizing materialization consumer, which invokes the existing targeted WorkerCoordinator executor. Relay continuity remains an optional stronger proof.

activation.claim_generation_rule: fresh WorkerCoordinator fencing generation; no historical claim/fence reuse

portable_refresh_then_execute.source_root_requirement: already-local current StegVerse-Labs/.github + StegOS + continuity-vault-kit source
